page_title: CAG 2-1 PAR | Cagliari v Parma 09/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+1' Substitution. Giovanni Leoni is replaced by Pontus Almqvist (Parma).
90+1' Marco Di Bello shows a yellow card to Hernani (Parma) for a tough tackle.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Dennis Man (Parma) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
88' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) receives a nice lofted pass and rips a snap shot from the edge of the box. His kick misses the goal and flies high over the crossbar.
85' That will be all from Roberto Piccoli who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari).
84' Davide Nicola decides to make a substitution. Antoine Makoumbou will be replaced by Razvan Marin (Cagliari).
84' A substitution has been made. Michel Adopo goes off and Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) comes on.
78' 2 - 1 Giovanni Leoni (Parma) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header into the top right corner. Excellent finish.
78' A quickly taken corner by Parma.
76' The game is interrupted as Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) is flagged offside.
74' Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.

74' Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear. The ball is out of play. Parma will have a chance to score from a corner.
73' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Now Parma have a corner.
70' 2 - 0 Florinel Coman (Cagliari) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and curls the ball into the top left corner in trademark fashion.
69' Substitution. Florinel Coman (Cagliari) on for Mattia Felici.
68' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Parma, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
68' Parma have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
65' Mattia Felici (Cagliari) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Zion Suzuki reacts superbly to deny him.
62' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Cagliari.
61' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
60' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. Cagliari force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
58' Here is a change. Mandela Keita is going off and Fabio Pecchia gives the last tactical orders to Hernani (Parma).
58' Substitution. Drissa Camara makes way for Jacob Ondrejka (Parma).
57' 1 - 0 Here is an example of luck not being on your side. Alessandro Vogliacco (Parma) unluckily turns a cross into his own net.
57' Cagliari failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
57' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
55' Marco Di Bello shows a yellow card to Drissa Camara (Parma), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
54' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Nicolas Viola as he is replaced by Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari).

54' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) produces a great solo run in the middle of the field, zig-zags through the opposition's defence at full speed and fires a powerful strike that crashes against the right post. What a chance!
52' Simon Sohm (Parma) latches on to a sweet cross into the box and misses with a header way wide of the left post.
49' Mattia Felici (Cagliari) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
48' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Cagliari.
46' Half-time substitution. Matteo Cancellieri will not participate anymore and Dennis Man (Parma) is coming on.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
45+1' Mattia Felici (Cagliari) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Good work from Cagliari as they win a corner.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' The resulting set piece from Parma is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
40' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Parma players look gutted.
40' Wait! Referee Marco Di Bello has indicated he is going to review the Parma goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
40' It's a goal! Lovely finish directed into the back of the net by Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma).
38' Mattia Felici (Cagliari) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

38' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort. The ball goes behind for a corner. Cagliari will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
35' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) is penalised for holding. Marco Di Bello signals a set piece.
31' Fabio Pecchia is forced to make a change. Milan Djuric is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma).
31' Milan Djuric (Parma) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
31' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
27' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Zion Suzuki intercepts the ball.
26' Drissa Camara (Parma) latched on to an accurate pass deep into the box and attempted to fire the ball past the keeper, but the shot is way off target. What a miskick!
24' CHANCE! Yerry Mina (Cagliari) rises high to meet the resultant corner kick and attempts to steer his fine header past the goalkeeper, but only hits the right post!
24' There's an opportunity for Mattia Felici (Cagliari) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

23' Mattia Felici (Cagliari) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Zion Suzuki anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. Cagliari have been awarded a corner kick.

19' Ambitious effort from Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the left post.
17' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block.
15' Great teamplay by Cagliari as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
12' Drissa Camara (Parma) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
10' The free kick from a promising distance is taken by Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma), who fires in a direct effort just wide of the right post. What a chance!
9' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick has been awarded to Parma.
8' A cross into the box from Mattia Felici (Cagliari) is cleared.
6' Parma take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
6' Drissa Camara (Parma) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Parma earn a corner.
4' An accurate cross picks out Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar.
2' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) missed a great opportunity! He jumped for a cross and headed towards goal from the penalty spot, but the ball sailed well wide of the left post!
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Cagliari will kick the game off.
Marco Di Bello will supervise the game today.
